payload.reason: The evidence discusses the generation of additional data from translations, specifically highlighting the effectiveness of using multiple back-translations to improve data quality.

claims.text: Using back-translations from multiple languages can significantly increase the amount of additional data generated for discourse relation classification.
The size of the extra data generated can be about 10 times larger than other methods, indicating a substantial increase in data volume.
The best results in terms of data quality are achieved when at least two back-translations agree, which optimizes the reliability of the labels.
